lines.zh: 我走一步，身形就错开一截。
lines.en: I take a step and my outline splits a notch.

lines.zh: 我靠近的时候会突然变近。
lines.en: When I approach, I'm suddenly closer.
My position doesn't match my sound.
I walk dragging half a shadow.

lines.zh: 我的动作中间缺了一块。
lines.en: There's a gap in the middle of my movement.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方颜色不对。
lines.en: The color is wrong where I pass.
I step along as if caught in place.

lines.zh: 我的头转过来，脸还没转。
lines.en: My head comes around before my face does.

lines.zh: 我每次一闪，都更近一点。
lines.en: Every flicker brings me a little nearer.
I stop all at once, then move all at once.
I leave afterimages behind me.
I stand, my shape breaking up.
My name doesn't quite read properly.
I'm waiting to continue.
My motion stopped halfway.
I'm not fully formed.
The sound of my breathing is wrong.

lines.zh: 我在你视野里闪了一下。
lines.en: I flicker in your sight.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛只有一个清楚。
lines.en: Only one of my eyes is clear.
I keep turning in place.
Part of me hasn't arrived yet.
My raised hand got stuck.
I start looking a little more normal.
I slowly line my face up.
You're seeing half of me.
I'm not finished.
Will you remember this image?
I'm right in front of you.
Why are you still watching?
There's an echo when I speak.
What do I look like?
My face is still loading.

lines.zh: 我眨了一下眼，慢了半拍。
lines.en: I blinked half a beat late.
This position isn't very stable.
I'm still missing something.
Keep your eyes where they are.
This has already happened.
You only just realized.

lines.zh: 我说话时你会听见两次。
lines.en: You will hear me twice when I speak.
My frame cracked.
I backed off one tile.
A section of my shape came apart.
I'm not sure if I'm hurt.
I snapped back into place.
The error repeated.
My color dropped out.
You hit empty air.
I'm back again.
I'm still here. The model's unfinished.

lines.zh: 吃东西这件事与我无关。
lines.en: Eating has nothing to do with me.
You're talking to a glitch.
That thing doesn't exist for me.
You holding that is a strange image.
I don't need anything.
Put it away; it'll jam.
It vanishes when it reaches me.
Save it for yourself.
That isn't the part I'm missing.
I cannot make out its shape.
I don't have a body at this moment.
The impact put me out of place.
When you pulled back, I was still there.
We touched twice.
The second time was the first time.
The shove made me flicker.
My position shifted one tile.
You nearly hit one of my afterimages.

lines.zh: 我们靠得太近，画面糊了。
lines.en: Too close; the image has gone blurry.

lines.zh: 这个名字后面还有别的。
lines.en: There's another form behind this name.
It and I share one position.
It's where I haven't arrived yet.
We're never both whole at once.
It's a little clearer than I am.
What I'm missing is what it has.
There's a blank stretch between us.
You've seen it already.
Soon I'll become it.
Don't record this.

lines.zh: 我伸了手，什么也没拿到。
lines.en: I reached out and caught nothing.

lines.zh: 这个东西穿过我的手指。
lines.en: The thing passes through my fingers.

lines.zh: 我的手伸过去，画面卡住了。
lines.en: I reach out and the frame freezes.
I pick it up and drop it.
It's outside my frame.
I can see it; I can't touch it.
I tried to grab it three times.
The third try failed too.
Perhaps it isn't here at all.
You've walked into this segment.
I'm starting to go wrong.
My position is closer than before.
The picture is going unsteady.
I'll keep closing in.
I don't need to walk over.
The edges of this room are wrong.

lines.zh: 你一回头，我的脸还没转过来。
lines.en: You turn, and my face has not turned yet.
I haven't fully appeared yet.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在我这里很响。
lines.en: Your breathing is loud from here.
This distance is strange.
I can't count my own steps.
You're starting to go wrong too.
Don't try to count me.

lines.zh: 你正好在我该在的位置。
lines.en: You are exactly where I should be.
I already took this step in advance.
I stay in your frame.
You take one step; I get closer twice.

lines.zh: 我的影子对不上我的脚。
lines.en: My shadow doesn't line up with my feet.

lines.zh: 我直接穿墙，位置对不正。
lines.en: I pass through the wall and my position will not line up.
One moment I'm here.
The next I'm over there.
Your breath is audible to me.
You've started counting.
The smaller the number, the closer I am.
I keep replaying this frame.
How many times have you looked back?
I keep repeating this stretch.
Your shadow is starting to go wrong.
I can't judge distance.
My name is still inside the glitch.
I'll get closer still.
Something's wrong with the door.
Whatever you do, do not switch off the light.
I have been eyeing you a while.

lines.zh: 我伸手过来，你没感觉到。
lines.en: My hand comes at you unseen.
That landed somewhere else.
I touched your shoulder.
There is no mark on you to be found.
Half of that strike is missing.
You pulled back, and I'm ahead of you.
The picture flashed.
I don't know if that connected.
The sound you heard isn't mine.
That one repeated.
Your certainty has begun to slip.

lines.zh: 我的手落在你肩上，又消失。
lines.en: My hand lands on your shoulder, then is gone.
Don't look back.
I've appeared in the frame.
The name is starting to fail.
Only part of me is here.
This stretch has repeated.

lines.zh: 我从半帧画面里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of half a frame.
The light breaks at a point on me.

lines.zh: 我站在门口，也没站在那。
lines.en: I'm in the doorway, and also not.
My figure is loading.
Things are going wrong here.
I come into focus bit by bit.
I raise my head; my face shivers.

lines.zh: 我看你一眼，名字就乱了。
lines.en: One look from me and the name garbles.
That glance froze.
I haven't quite stood up.
I'm still forming.
I look good in this frame.
You'll remember it.
This is the first segment.

lines.zh: 火光里我的轮廓更乱了。
lines.en: In the firelight my outline frays further.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，落到一半又回来了。
lines.en: I fell halfway down, then came back.
Water comes over me and I blur more.
A white flash and I'm missing a piece.
Something passes through me, and nothing happens.
Light freezes this segment of me.

lines.zh: 我这具身子根本不需要胃。
lines.en: This body of mine has no use for a stomach.

lines.zh: 雷光让整段画面都白了。
lines.en: The flash whites the whole frame out.

lines.zh: 这里没有画面可以放我。
lines.en: There's no frame here to hold me.
